# sspi_user_password (Resource)

Manages SSPI local user passwords.

When `username` is not set, changes the password of the currently authenticated user via `POST /sspi/iam/change-password` (requires `current_password`).

When `username` is set, performs an administrator-driven reset of that local user's password (e.g. `admin` or `audit`) via `POST /sspi/iam/reset-password` (`current_password` is not required or used for this path).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `new_password` (String, Sensitive) New password to set.

### Optional

- `current_password` (String, Sensitive) Current password of the authenticated user. Required when `username` is not set (self password change); ignored for administrator resets.
- `username` (String) The local user whose password should be reset by an administrator (e.g. `admin`, `audit`). When omitted, the password of the currently authenticated user is changed instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the password action.
